AgentStage.description:
One desk stage and whether Ask the Tape knows it.

BUSINESS: the screen's scope strip: "Knows: Tape ✓ · Slotting ✓ · BestEx –".
TECH: id from agent/stages.py; step is the roadmap step; state is "known" (the
  desk has run it), "not_run" (built, not run on this tape) or "planned".
AgentStage.title: AgentStage

AskRequest.description:
POST /api/ask body.

BUSINESS: a typed question, or a desk-question chip's id (which skips the model).
TECH: question length is checked against llm.toml max_question_chars in
  ask_input, so the limit lives in config.

desk_question.description: A desk question id, e.g. ltv_over_125
desk_question.title: Desk Question

question.description: The visitor's question, in plain English
question.title: Question

AskRequest.title: AskRequest

AskStatus.description:
Who answers this visitor's next typed question.

BUSINESS: the screen shows a small banner when built-in rules ("Offline") are
  answering because the model is switched off or a daily limit is reached.
TECH: mode "model" or "offline"; reason is the orchestrator's fallback code
  (unavailable, daily_budget, visitor_limit); notice is its visitor-facing words
  from content/ask-the-tape.json.
AskStatus.title: AskStatus

Breakdowns.description:
GET /api/loans/breakdowns: the three summary panels, whole tape.

TECH: programs largest balance first; note_rates in rate order, every bucket
  present (0 when empty); dq_status in the config order, then any status the
  config does not list.
Breakdowns.title: Breakdowns

ColumnInfo.description:
One tape column.

BUSINESS: default_visible marks the fields a trader reads first; the Loan Tape
  opens with only those showing (api.toml [columns]).
TECH: type is the DuckDB type; kind is what the grid filters on. The API always
  sends default_visible, so the generated TypeScript type makes it required.
ColumnInfo.title: ColumnInfo

Health.description: GET /api/health. BUSINESS: is the tape loaded, and how many loans are in it.
Health.title: Health

LoanRecord.description: One loan, every field. TECH: field name -> value (dates as ISO text).
LoanRecord.title: LoanRecord

LoanSlots.description:
GET /api/loans/{loan_id}/slots: the hover card.

BUSINESS: the loan's own facts, its pool and coupons (percent, as text, e.g.
  "2.5"), every story it fits with the rule and the reason, and the generic TBA
  slot that is always open; or, if it is not slotted, why.
LoanSlots.title: LoanSlots

LoanTapeLink.description:
How to open one answer in the Loan Tape.

BUSINESS: filter is None when the answer's filter cannot be shown as column
  filters; reason then says why, for the button's tooltip.
TECH: filter is AG Grid's filter model ({} = the whole tape); sort is the
  /api/loans sort string ("col:dir,col:dir") or None.

filter.description: AG Grid filter model, or None
filter.title: Filter

reason.description: Why the filter cannot be shown
reason.title: Reason

LoanTapeLink.title: LoanTapeLink

LoansPage.description: GET /api/loans. TECH: total counts every loan matching the filter, not just this page.
LoansPage.title: LoansPage

MonthPrices.description: One delivery month's prices for a product. TECH: 6a sends "Current" only.
MonthPrices.title: MonthPrices

NotSlotted.description: Why a loan is not slotted. TECH: reason is the code; short for the grid, text for the card.
NotSlotted.title: NotSlotted

PayupCell.description: One story's pay-up at one coupon. BUSINESS: in 32nds, and as "0-24+".
PayupCell.title: PayupCell

PayupRowOut.description: One story on one product. BUSINESS: full_32nds is the premium-coupon pay-up.
PayupRowOut.title: PayupRowOut

PriceCellOut.description: One coupon's TBA price. BUSINESS: coupon percent; price points; "101-23+".
PriceCellOut.title: PriceCellOut

PriceGrid.description:
GET /api/prices/grid.

BUSINESS: as_of is the Treasury curve's date; label is the line every price
  screen shows; curve_status says whether the curve was fetched today (live),
  kept from an earlier fetch because Treasury was down (cached), or the
  bundled sample (fixture). illustrative is always true.
PriceGrid.title: PriceGrid

ProductRow.description:
One price-grid row.

BUSINESS: current_coupon_pct = anchor_yield_pct + spread_pct, the coupon that
  trades at par today. traded_low_pct and traded_high_pct bound the actively
  traded coupons; cells outside are model_only.
ProductRow.title: ProductRow

ProgramSlice.description:
One bar of the Program mix panel.

BUSINESS: "Conventional: 812 loans, $212.8M current UPB".
TECH: current_upb in dollars (sum over the program's loans).
ProgramSlice.title: ProgramSlice

QuestionCount.description:
One desk-question chip: how many loans answer it.

BUSINESS: "LTV over 125: 20 loans". TECH: id matches config/desk_questions.toml
  and content/desk-questions.json (the label); current_upb in dollars.
QuestionCount.title: QuestionCount

RateBucket.description:
One bar of the Note rate distribution panel.

BUSINESS: "6.0-6.5%: 312 loans, $114.9M". The first bucket also holds any lower
  rate and the last any higher one, so no loan is left out.
TECH: low and high in percent; low is included, high excluded. low is null on the
  first bucket (open below) and high is null on the last (open above).
RateBucket.title: RateBucket

RerunRequest.description:
POST /api/ask/rerun body: a saved query's SQL and its tag.

TECH: the SQL's length is checked by sql_guard (llm.toml max_sql_chars).

sql.description: The saved query's SQL, as the agent ran it
sql.title: Sql

RerunRequest.title: RerunRequest

RulesSummary.description:
BUSINESS: what a run will check, for the confirm dialog (Step 5b): "12 rules in 4
spec stories: LLB tiers $85K to $275K, NY, PR, Low FICO". TECH: from the loaded rules.
RulesSummary.title: RulesSummary

SlottingStatus.description:
GET /api/slotting/status. TECH: run_at is UTC; totals null until a run finishes;
rules is always the rules in force (Step 5b).
SlottingStatus.title: SlottingStatus

SlottingTotals.description:
The counts a finished run reports.

BUSINESS: slotted + not_slotted = loans. by_agency: UMBS and GNMA II loans;
  by_reason: not-slotted loans by the first check they failed (no_agency,
  product, status); stories: slotted loans per story family (a loan can count in
  several); tiers: per LLB tier, loans whose lowest fitting tier it is;
  multi_story: loans with more than one story; generic_tba: slotted loans with
  none. coupons: the down and up coupon range, percent, as text ("1.5").
SlottingTotals.title: SlottingTotals

SourceOut.description: Where a number comes from. TECH: url is None for LoanIQ's own model.
SourceOut.title: SourceOut

StatusCount.description:
One line of the MBA delinquency panel.

BUSINESS: "60 days past due: 21 loans". TECH: current_upb in dollars.
StatusCount.title: StatusCount

StoredQuery.description:
One query_tape result, as the screen gets it.

BUSINESS: "Loans over 125 LTV: 20 rows" plus the SQL that produced them.
TECH: rows are lists in `columns` order (smaller JSON than dicts). row_count
  is rows returned (at most max_rows); total_rows counts every row that
  matched; truncated is True when total_rows > row_count. loan_tape is how to
  open the result in the Loan Tape with the same filter (loan_tape_link.py,
  Step 4b); None only for results stored before it existed. added_columns
  names the default tape columns the server joined on for display (Step 4c,
  tools.add_base_columns); the model never sees them and the SQL does not
  select them.
StoredQuery.title: StoredQuery

StoryFamily.description:
One spec-story family in force. BUSINESS: tiers are its caps' labels, lowest first
("85K" ... "275K"); empty for a story with no tiers (NY).
StoryFamily.title: StoryFamily

StoryFit.description: One spec story a loan fits. BUSINESS: rule is the SQL test; why is plain English.
StoryFit.title: StoryFit

Summary.description:
GET /api/loans/summary: the pool's headline numbers.

BUSINESS: weighted by current UPB, because a $900,000 loan matters more to the
  pool's value than a $90,000 one. Null when the tape is empty.
TECH: total_current_upb in dollars; wac and wa_ltv in percent; wa_fico in points.
Summary.title: Summary

TapeInfo.description:
GET /api/tape: the line under the screen title.

BUSINESS: "Seller tape · 41 fields · 6 fictional sellers".
TECH: fields is the number of tape columns; sellers counts distinct seller names.
TapeInfo.title: TapeInfo

info.description: Synthetic loan tape: paged, sorted and filtered in DuckDB. All data is synthetic; all numbers illustrative.
info.title: LoanIQ loan API

post.description:
BUSINESS: answer one question, streaming each step.

TECH: a plain (sync) generator; FastAPI runs it on a worker thread, so the
  blocking model calls never stall other requests.

get.description:
BUSINESS: the loan drawer: click a loan id in an answer, see the whole loan.

TECH: runs the agent's own get_loan tool (bound parameter, LN + 8 digits).
  400 for a malformed id, 404 for an id not on this tape.
BUSINESS: every row behind one answer. TECH: 404 if unknown or expired (1 hour).

post.description:
BUSINESS: rerun a saved query on the tape without asking the model again.

TECH: the SQL goes through the same sql_guard gate as the model's query_tape
  call (one SELECT, the loans table, known columns, bound values, row cap,
  timeout) and runs on the read-only tape. A refused query is a 400 with the
  guard's reason. No model call, so no cost and no visitor limit.

get.description:
BUSINESS: is the AI model answering right now, and which stages does it know?
TECH: no model call, no cost.
BUSINESS: is the tape loaded. TECH: loan count from COUNT(*).

BUSINESS: one page of the tape. TECH: bad sort or filter -> HTTP 400.

Annotated[LoansQuery, Query()] tells FastAPI to read the model's fields
from the URL's query string.

get.description:
BUSINESS: each desk-question chip's loan count, whole tape.
TECH: config order; the same rules /api/loans?question= applies.

schema.title: Response Questions Api Loans Questions Get

get.description: BUSINESS: the tape's headline numbers, weighted by current UPB.

BUSINESS: the hover card for one loan ID on the Loan Tape.

TECH: 400 for a malformed id (LN + 8 digits), 409 if slotting has not run, 404
  for an id not on this tape. The id goes in as a bound parameter.

BUSINESS: today's illustrative price file.

TECH: the first call of a New York day fetches Treasury's curve (up to the
  timeout); later calls reuse it. 503 if the configured source is a stub.

post.description:
BUSINESS: slot the whole tape, streaming each step with its counts.

TECH: a plain (sync) generator; FastAPI runs it on a worker thread. The server
  does not pause between steps: on 2,000 loans the whole run takes a fraction
  of a second, and the screen paces the commentary for the visitor.

get.description: BUSINESS: "Last run 11:42 AM" or "Not run on this tape". TECH: no query.
